feature: Mobile Community screen layout (in-scroller header/tabs/pills, 84px dock spacer)
detail: /app/explore is a desktop TwoColumnLayout (explore/page.tsx). No mobile pass yet (app-shell.tsx: 'until the mobile pass'). Gated by featureFlags.community.

feature: Header A1: logo + wordmark, round Search, blue round Create (+)
detail: Pieces exist in top-nav.tsx (LogoTile, Wordmark, CreateMenu). On mobile the search is hidden and Create is a stroke dropdown button.

feature: Inline feed search (A2) matching title, handle, description, tags and players
detail: /api/search/community matches list title and username only. Widen to description, list_tags and list_players, and add an in-feed search state with Cancel.

feature: Tabs: For you / Following / Start or sit / Rankings / Lists
detail: App has Trending / Newest / Following. Need a ruling on dropping Trending/Newest and on how For you is ranked.

feature: Topic pills incl. player pills with headshots and the Injuries trend pill
detail: Tags exist (useTags trending). Filtering by player needs a list_players join. Who curates the topic list, and what Injuries means, are open.

feature: 'Updated by people you follow' block with move summary and unread dot
detail: follows + lists.updated_at exist, but ranking_history is never written (no app code or trigger), and there is no per-viewer read state. The list_updated notification goes to pinners, not author followers.

feature: Start/sit poll cards: Start/Sit N of M, multi-select, Vote, results bars/percentages, vote footer
detail: start_sit_questions/start_sit_votes are 2-player A/B only, with no API routes. /app/start-or-sit/* are PlaceholderPage. Needs N-of-M options, sit mode, per-option aggregates and vote APIs.

feature: Trade polls (Gives/Gets, instant Accept/Decline vote, results)
detail: No community trade-poll model. League trades/trade_votes are unrelated.

feature: Roster attached on polls (snapshot of poster's league roster, highlighted players)
detail: No snapshot stored with a post. League rosters exist but are flag-gated.

feature: Start or sit carousel shelf (286px equal-height cards, See all)
detail: Depends on the poll backend.

feature: Closed-poll exclusion and close-at-kickoff rule
detail: Only voting_closes_at on the 2-player schema.

feature: Rankings this week shelf + ranking rows (lead-headshot tile, follows meta, top-3 line)
detail: Rankings = lists with ranking_mode != 'unranked'. follower_count and list_players exist. The feed query needs top players.

feature: Rank filter rows: type (Weekly/ROS/Pre-draft) x position x scoring
detail: position_filter and scoring_system_id exist. Weekly can come from big_board_weekly and pre-draft from is_big_board, but nothing marks a list Rest of season. Also show an empty state when the chips exclude everything (A8 quirk).

feature: Lists for you masonry (2-column, variable cover heights, collage of 4 headshots, byline)
detail: The feed query lacks players and links. cover-tile.tsx renders a wide band with stacked headshots, not a centred 2x2 collage.

feature: List card video badge and YouTube thumbnail covers
detail: list_links (080) has kind='video', url, title, duration_label. Loading i.ytimg.com thumbnails needs a ruling: list-details-tab.tsx deliberately shows a placeholder, and there are no image hosts in next.config.

feature: Grouped mode with section headings
detail: Feed is a flat row list. Polls section depends on the backend.

feature: Empty states A6/A7 copy and layout
detail: explore-feed.tsx has following and topic empty states with different copy.

feature: Detail page cover (230px collage, floating back button) and mobile layout
detail: Public list route /u/[username]/lists/[slug] and /app/lists/[id] exist (public-list-view.tsx).

feature: Detail Follow pill and author follower count
detail: FollowButton and follower_count exist but aren't on the list detail hero.

feature: Detail kind pill 'List' / 'Ranking · PPR'
detail: ranking_mode and scoring_system_id exist.

feature: Detail Save/Saved
detail: Exists as Pin (pin-list-button.tsx, list_favorites). Renaming to Save is a copy call.

feature: Detail Videos shelf (220px cards, play badge, duration chip)
detail: list_links rendered as rows in the Details tab today. Thumbnail has the same ytimg question.

feature: Detail player rows with projection
detail: Data exists. Conflict: D497 makes projections dark blue site-wide, but the design uses t1.

feature: Ranking detail move column (+4 / -3)
detail: ranking_history exists but is never written.

feature: Create sheet (Start or sit / Ranking / List rows)
detail: CreateMenu offers List + league. A bottom Sheet primitive exists. List/Ranking creation exists via list-form-dialog; the Start or sit row needs the poll backend.

feature: Post-to-Community flow (prepend, reset filters, toast 'Posted to Community')
detail: Public lists appear in Newest automatically. Polls need the backend.

feature: List cover colour (author colour / composer swatch)
detail: lists has no colour column, and Chris's 2026-08-11 ruling (cover-tile.tsx) makes covers position-group coloured.

feature: Author identity colour avatars
detail: profiles has avatar_url only; UserAvatar shows photo/initials on grey. Should colour be stored or hashed?

feature: Likes, comments, top scouts, trending tags absent from the design
detail: The app has LikeButton, comment counts, TopScoutsCard, TrendingTagsCard and a comments tab. Keep or drop them on mobile?

feature: FSHeadshot team-colour ring
detail: PlayerAvatarImage has an initials fallback but no team ring. Team colours exist in lib/nfl-team-colors.

feature: Toast timing/position (1800ms, bottom 100, replace-on-new)
detail: ui/toast.tsx is already an ink pill.

feature: Bottom tab bar Home / Community / Players / Profile-avatar
detail: bottom-tabs.tsx is Home / Lists / Players / Search / More.

feature: Tab bar IA change (drop Lists/Search/More, add Community)
detail: Community and start-or-sit are flag-gated off for the 2026 go-live.

feature: Global search: person result opens Community filtered by handle; poll results
detail: command-palette sends users to their profile (memory rule: usernames always link to profile). Poll results need the backend.

feature: Device chrome: status bar, notch, home indicator
detail: Prototype-only. Don't build.

feature: League sub-page overlay header + G2 settings read-only rows
detail: settings-panel.tsx already renders read-only for non-commissioners. Leagues are flag-gated.

feature: G1 team rename with counter/dirty Save
detail: POST /api/leagues/[id]/teams/[tid]/name + use-rename-own-team exist.

feature: G1 team avatar colour + Upload photo
detail: teams has no avatar/colour column.

feature: G3 Draft results by round with owner
detail: draft-recap.tsx + draft_picks. Per-round chip list is new. Add an empty-round state.

feature: G4 current-season H2H table + Record/PF/PA KPIs
detail: stats-page.tsx has H2H W-L/PF/PA for the one season.

feature: G4 All-time/past-season chips and Start/sit accuracy (optimal lineup) KPI
detail: One season per league. No optimal-lineup computation.

feature: G5 Previous seasons
detail: No league renewal/archive; leagues.season is single.

feature: Dark mode tokens and the listed dark defects
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme, but worktree commit 27d455b adds mobile-only dark tokens (--m-*), theme-store and a switch (cites a Chris 2026-10-15 ruling). The defects (white check on dark, t1 swatch/cover turning white, t2/t3 avatars) need decisions.
